## 1. Get Started

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(spData)
```

You will be working with the following datasets: - High points in New Zealand, obtained from spData - Artificial grain dataset (with three classes: clay, silt, and sand), obtained from spData

```{r}
nz_height <- nz_height
grain <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/grain.tif", package = "spData"))
```
